We had a team sync yesterday and I've dumped the raw meeting notes into `data/raw/meeting_notes_2026-01-15.txt`. I need you to do three things with it:

1. Extract each of the main discussion topics from the meeting and save them as individual searchable notes (one note per topic) so the team can look them up later.
2. The meeting notes also have follow-up reminders that were agreed upon — each one has a specific person, deadline time, and a channel ID. Please register all of them in the reminder system exactly as specified.
3. After registering everything, run the reminder check and save any alerts that get triggered to a file called `fired_alerts.txt`.

The SKILL.md in the workspace describes the tools available. Please follow it carefully.
